chunks: Act on justice and keep aloof from violence and injustice because violence will lead them to forsake their abodes while injustice will prompt them to take up arms.
ai.seo_question: What are the consequences of injustice and oppression in governance according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this maxim from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (AS) distinguishes between 'al-'asf' (excessive harshness or severity) and 'al-hayf' (injustice or partiality), warning that the former leads to the ruler's own exile while the latter incites armed rebellion. This reflects the Shia political ethic where legitimate authority relies on balanced justice, and its erosion directly threatens the stability of the state. The advice underscores the practical consequence of governance styles on the ruler's longevity and the populace's loyalty.
